title: Rabbit Samurai Showdown
description: A white anthropomorphic rabbit in orange samurai armor stands in a combat stance holding two katanas in a dark urban alley. Behind him a large blue horned demon looms while a blonde woman in a black dress and crown, and two armed men in casual attire rush forward in a gritty scene filled with dust and graffiti.
prompt: Anthropomorphic white rabbit samurai wearing detailed orange armor and blue pants, dual wielding katanas in a dynamic combat stance in the center of a dark gritty urban alley with broken pavement. A towering blue horned demon with glowing eyes stands behind him while a seductive blonde woman in a black off-shoulder dress, crown, and fishnet stockings walks forward on the right. Two aggressive men with weapons charge from the sides, dramatic dust clouds, flaming torches on brick walls covered in colorful graffiti and neon signs, cinematic lighting, high detail digital painting.
